query: SELECT p.title FROM reviews r JOIN products p ON r.category = p.category AND r.ref_id = p.ref_id WHERE r.rating = 1 GROUP BY p.ref_id, p.title ORDER BY COUNT(r.rating) DESC LIMIT 1
